scars.description: Standard prompt-based AI interaction led to 'Resolution Collapse', where the AI averaged out conflicting stakeholder constraints to present a smoothed, false output. This represented a narrative ambiguity failure.
scars.resolution: Implemented the Agentic Inversion Protocol. The AI acts as the Structural Arbiter (Strategic Integration Project Manager) utilizing SPZ-Zeta semantics, while the Human acts as the Paraconsistent Oracle. This ensures that tension (Beneficial Friction) is mapped topologically rather than averaged out.
